scene earlymorning
When the morning comes and most of the girls are sleeping, there is one who wanders off.
She’s not unused to waking up at this hour of the day — she’s been doing it since she was a child.
A checklist posted on the door of a tiny kitchen would remind her of what needed to be done before she went to school each morning.
Make your bed.
Do your homework.
Make breakfast.
Take a shower.
Get dressed.
And it wasn’t like she would forget to do these things if the list did not exist — she just simply liked having something to correspond with since it was always silent around this time.
It wasn’t as fulfilling as talking to someone, but it was still something. And she did have scattered phone calls to look forward to every now and then when the times lined up.
They just often didn’t.
As the years went by, more items were added to her morning lists.
Read a chapter of a book.
Exercise for thirty minutes.
Check your messages and emails.
As her mornings grew busier, she accepted that some days, she would have to skip certain entries in order to make it to class on time.
It was okay if she didn’t make her bed.
It was okay if she didn’t make breakfast.
It was okay if she never made breakfast.
There are tons of people who don’t eat breakfast. Plus, there were other meals later on in the day that would be more than enough to fill her up.
Everything would be fine in the end because she wasn’t doing anything wrong.
But then she was.
And today-
scene futabaimanibath1
Today is a day where the list does not exist.
But, as she remembers what is meant to be on it, she has decided to begin her morning with a bath — long before anyone would have a chance of seeing her.
scene futabaimanibath2
Or so she thought.
scene futabaimanibath3
You see, this girl wasn’t the only person used to being awake at this time of day.
But the one who beat her to the punch on this particular morning was never good at waking up early.
In fact, most nights, she didn’t sleep at all.
Last night, it happened again — but for reasons much different than the ones she’s grown used to.
Just like the other girl, she wasn’t particularly comfortable with baring her full self in front of others.
And just like the other girl, she wasn’t particularly comfortable with doing that in front of herself either.
The only times she’d be caught gazing into mirrors were when her morbid curiosity would reach its peak.
And as she’d stare into the eyes of someone she only partially recognized, she’d remember why she was so alone despite her age.
: Miss Imai?...
The two of them were similar in a number of ways.
They both liked to read.
They both found the scent of cinnamon relaxing and nostalgic.
And they both preferred to pleasure themselves in the morning instead of the night.
But always with their clothes on.
There was one key difference, though.
For one of them, this trait was something they were born with.
: Heeeey...what are you doing up so early?
For the other, it was gained.
scene black
: I always wake up around this time...What about you?
: I wasn’t really...expecting anyone else to be in here yet.
scene futabaimanibath4
: Yeah...same here.
: Uhh...just out of curiosity, is...is anybody else on their way too? Or...
: No...I came here alone. And apart from Ayane who’s still missing, the rest of the girls in my room aren’t awake yet.
: Ayane’s not back yet? Seriously?
: Yeah...but Ami seemed pretty adamant that she’d be okay, so...
: Hah...You girls and these damn risky contests. I’m gonna have to be a lot stricter for the next Dorm Wars, aren’t I?
scene futabaimanibath5
: Sorry for making this harder on you when you already work so much.
: It’s fine, it’s fine. You’re one of the good ones. I just hope Ayane isn’t too lost or we’re gonna have to replace all of today’s contests with a competitive search party instead.
: That’s not a bad idea...turning it into a competition. With Sensei on the line, I’m sure both floors would tear apart the whole forest in a matter of hours.
: Yeah. You’re all pretty obsessed with him, after all. And that really shines when you guys do stuff like this.
: Some of the girls get...a little more competitive than others in our group outings. But, for the most part I...try not to get in the way of that.
: I hear you there, Futaba. Can barely talk to him at these things without worrying somebody’s gonna show up out of nowhere and stab me in the back.
: Well...if it’s any consolation, I promise I came here unarmed and that your back is safe for now.
: Thanks, Futaba. I promise I won’t try to assassinate you either.
: I’m glad we were able to reach a truce.
: Just for the Dorm Wars, of course. But once this is over? You better watch your back.
scene futabaimanibath6
: Hahah...got it. I’ll be keeping an eye on you.
scene futabaimanibath7
: Things not to say in the bath, volume one.
: Hahah! You’re right, you’re right. We should be more careful with our words or one of us might get the wrong idea.
: Absolutely. I like you and all, Futaba. You’re just a little too young for me.
: And you’re a little too-
: Black?
: Wha- no! Miss Imai! I was going to say “feminine!”
scene futabaimanibath8
: I’m sorry, I’m sorry. But how could I not jump on you with an opportunity like that?
: Things not to say in the bath, volume two.
scene futabaimanibath9
: Heeey! Look at us! We’ve got our own little inside joke now! It’s only a matter of time at this point until we’re forming a tennis doubles team or riding a tandem bicycle together.
: Ahh, yes. The natural progression of friendship. It feels like just yesterday I was having my first bike ride with Nodoka.
scene futabaimanibath10
: Let me guess — she took the seat off and rode the pole directly.
: Haha, that does sound like something she’d do, doesn’t it?
: Girl’s so thirsty I wouldn’t be surprised if part of it came off and just got permanently stuck in there.
: You’re right about that. But at least we can admire her...tenacity?
: Is that what we’re calling it now? Tenacity?
scene futabaimanibath5
: That’s what I’m calling it because I’ve known her for so long that I can’t help but give her the benefit of the doubt.
: And even if Nodoka is being serious about all of that stuff-
: Which she is.
: Maybe. But even if she is being serious, I can’t help but admire her...willingness to be open about her interests and...
: And that...extreme confidence she has about everything.
: Like she’s aware of how amazing she is in every way and just...leverages it every chance she gets.
: I admire her encyclopedic intellect, for sure. But all that confidence and tenacity make me want to punt her sometimes. Kirin too.
scene futabaimanibath11
: Hahah...that’s fair.
: I might just be biased since those are qualities I’ve always longed for myself...but I can’t help but look up to Nodoka. Even with her many apparent flaws.
: You long to be a horny human-computer?
scene futabaimanibath12
: Wha- no. Obviously not. What I really want is her confidence. She’s amazing at everything and always knows how to use that to her advantage.
scene futabaimanibath13
: Confidence? What don’t you have to be confident about? You’re kind and smart and driven and a billion other things everybody else wants to be but totally sucks at. Nodoka included.
: It’s less...what’s on the inside and...
: More of...what everyone can see...
scene futabaimanibath14
: Futaba, no way...You?
: Do you really mean that?
: I-I’m not trying to vent or anything! It’s just...you asked, so...
: It’s fine to vent. I’m your teacher and I care about you. I just...never would have expected that.
: I-I don’t blame you! Not at all! You’re just...you’re so beautiful that...I can’t imagine stupid things like this ever even cross your mind.
scene futabaimanibath15
: I’m not beautiful.
: Not even close.
: What are you talking about? Of course you are. You’re slim and stylish...and your eyes are such a gorgeous shade of blue. Not to mention your hair. Everything about you is perfect and I’m-
: Actually beautiful.
: Not the kind of “beautiful” that has to pay close attention to every aspect of her person just to make sure people focus more on the flashy parts than the hideous ones.
scene futabaimanibath16
: What would I even distract anyone with? How am I supposed to know what to make people focus on when I can barely even look at myself in the mirror?

: If you’re not looking in the mirror, you’re missing out. Your skin? Flawless. Your hair? Beautiful and silky and soft. And those eyes? Well, let’s just say I ain’t the only one here who’s lucky in that area.
: Also, you’re rockin’ friggin’ F’s or something. And you don’t even need to try and get people to focus on those since they’re always going to anyway. Ain’t nobody starin’ at my chest.
: Thank you...for all of that. But I just don’t see it that way.
: What I see when I look in the mirror is...
: It’s disgusting...
: I used to be skinny. Or...skinny-ish at least...
: I eat healthy...I exercise...and I’ve even...resorted to...other methods in the past...but nothing works.
: Nothing gets me to where I want to be...And even if I did manage to get skinnier, I’m not sure if there would be a place I can be happy with at all.
: What if I...always see myself as a freak?
: Don’t use that word...
: I’m sorry...I’ve...
: I’ve already told Sensei in the past that I’m going to try and talk a little bit better about myself...it’s just hard...
: And...talking about it with someone like you...someone who’s just so stunning in every single way...makes me feel like I’m complaining when-
: Hah...
scene futabaimanibath17
: Miss...Imai?
: Hold whatever thought you have, Futaba. I’m coming to the other side of the rock.
: It’s...okay if you stay over there. I can talk louder if you need me to. And I’d...I’d actually...prefer you stay over there, since...
scene futabaimanibath18
: Yeah, I’d prefer that too.
scene futabaimanibath19
: That’s why I came out here so early after all.
: I don’t really like letting other people see the “real” me.
: Buuuuuut...if you’re gonna look up to me and...call me “beautiful” and stuff, I should probably do the right thing and show you that you’re not alone in battling your reflection.
: Just...
scene futabaimanibath20
: This...isn’t exactly comfortable for me so...d...don’t feel weird if I have trouble making eye contact.
: Miss Imai...
: Imani is fine...No need to be so formal when we’re naked...
: Then...Imani...
: You can go ahead and keep ranting. Just because I’m not looking doesn’t mean I’m not listening.
: I’m done ranting for now...
: I just want you to know that...you really are beautiful.
scene futabaimanibath21
: Th...Thanks, but...you realize I don’t feel that way, right?...And you realize how it’s the same exact thing for you?
: Maybe...Maybe you’re right and the two of us will be stuck dodging mirrors for the rest of our lives.
: And maybe there will be people who shame us or...laugh at us for the way we look, but...
: We...We can...find solace in the fact that we can see each other in the light we wish we could see ourselves in.
: Thank you.
: Really.
: Hearing that from...someone who looks at themself the same way I do...
: It’s comforting.
: Like I said...I just wanted to make sure you didn’t feel alone...
: It worked...
: I don’t feel alone anymore.
: Cooooool...
scene futabaimanibath22
: Okay! I’m gonna go back to my side of the rock now.
: You should stay for a little while longer. It’s easier to talk like this.
scene futabaimanibath23
: Easier for you, maybe. I can count the people who have seen me like this on one hand.
: Well, I’m glad you decided to add me to that hand. And I’m glad I got to see this side of you.
scene futabaimanibath24
: Again, it wasn’t like I was just gonna let you hate yourself all a-
scene futabaimanibath25
: Yo seriously, though. What the fuck?
: They’re G’s, by the way. Not F’s.
: Uh-huh. And how old are you again?
: Things not to say in the bath, volume three.
: Jesus fuckin’ Christmas, I’d hate to be your shoulders.
: Oh, Fukuyama’s here as well. Move.
scene futabaimanibath26
: Well, that was certainly one of the worst nights of sleep I’ve ever had.
: Wakana. You realize we were, like...totally having a moment. Right?
scene futabaimanibath27
: Were you? Because it appeared as if you were just staring at her breasts.
: I mean...that was only part of the moment.
: Hahah...hah...
: Imani, I know last night may have awoken certain feelings in you, but I should remind you that, contrary to her buxomness, Fukuyama is, in fact, still in high school.
scene futabaimanibath28
: I was just admiring them! It wasn’t weird!
: Did, umm...did something happen in your room last night?...
scene futabaimanibath29
: Yeaaaah, but we’re not gonna talk about that.
: We’re not going to talk about anything. We’re just going to sit here and relax and be pretty.
: And formulate our plan to kill Arakawa once everyone wakes up.
scene black
: I’m confused...
: It’s probably for the best that you remain that way...
And they all lived happily ever after.
For real this time.
